entities.name: big covered ox cart
entities.what: Large two-wheeled cart with a woven-mat barrel roof over a panelled body, a big spoked wheel near its middle, a basket hung at the rear and a rolled blind or round hamper at its front; it faces east, a driver seated on its footboard, one shaft running forward to its team of three oxen (S4.ani.ox_shaft_9972, ox_far_10045, ox_lead_10235). The first of the ox carts that continue into S4.
entities.vis: part: wheel bottom and rear hidden by the bushy tree
entities.src: 名画记: 牛拉大盖车 (pin 31) / sections.md: the three-ox family carts at x ≈ 9300–10550
entities.note: continues past 9400: rear (cover's rear edge u 9330, chassis beam end u 9360) is in S5, front and draught in S4. By the ownership rule (front) it belongs to S4; recorded here on request. Wheel: rim u 9463-9637, hub (9545, 1325); contact estimated a radius below the hub. Cover top v ~1093, bed v ~1215-1240. Oxen and the driver are not recorded (u > 9750). Seam entity: its front (u 9800) is in S4; kept in S5 because its rear stands at the bridge's east end. S4 seam notes: front = ground under the shafts' front ends at the shaft ox's fore hooves (9960, 1455, est), not 9800; the body's front panel at u ~9688, a footboard to 9750 where the seated driver (S4.fig.ox_driver_seated_9815) rests his feet; one shaft shows, (9690,1313) -> (9880,1308); the yoke is not clearly drawn (a tangle of collars and ropes at u 9950-10010, v 1320-1390, tassels at (10022,1397) and (10081,1395); yoke est (9965,1330)); rope traces from (9690,1335) to the shaft ox's rump; no second wheel visible; a rolled blind or round hamper at u 9690-9760, v 1195-1310. Near wheel re-measured: rim 9464-9637, hub (9543,1328), contact est (9545,1415). Its team and drivers are S4's (S4.grp.cart_9800_team).
